C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and related forms like 2 + 3/2) into equivalent improper fractions to enable fraction operations.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a form like a b/c or a + b/c into a single fraction
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
Only simplifying a fraction (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4) without any mixed-number conversion

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM/common denominator for two denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to rewrite fractions with the same denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the step directly subtracts numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without aligning denominators

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Compute the subtraction once quantities are in compatible form (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts), producing the numeric difference.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts fractions with the same denominator using (a−b)/d
A step subtracts by separating whole and fractional parts (e.g., (3−3)+(4/5−2/5))
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or converting representations without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the result after subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction using common factors (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4)
A step states or checks that a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes the mixed-number equivalent)
exclusion_criteria: Any step whose main action is finding a common denominator or performing the subtraction
Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions at the start of the problem

A.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number into an equivalent improper fraction (and/or rewrite a mixed form like a + b/c as a single fraction).
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly rewrites a mixed number (e.g., 3 1/2) as an improper fraction (e.g., 7/2)
A step rewrites a mixed number written unusually (e.g., 2 3/2) into a sum and then into an improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S02 instead)
Only simplifying a fraction (tag S04 instead)
Only finding a common denominator or scaling fractions (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Rewrite whole as fraction
skills.definition: Express an integer as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator to enable fraction operations.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites an integer as k/k-denominator form (e.g., 3 = 15/5, 2 = 16/8, 4 = 12/3)
The denominator is chosen to match another fraction’s denominator (already given or planned)
exclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction (tag S01 instead)
Finding an LCM or building a common denominator between two non-integer fractions (tag S03 instead)
Performing the subtraction itself (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step identifies a common denominator/LCM for two fractions with different denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to convert both fractions to the common denominator (e.g., to /12, /18, /24)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is needed (go to S04)
Only rewriting an integer to a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S02 instead)
Only simplifying after subtraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract and simplify
skills.definition: Subtract fractions (including mixed-number cases once expressed compatibly) and present the result in simplest form (including recognizing 0 or whole-number results).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (or subtracts identical fractions) to compute the difference
A step simplifies the resulting fraction (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4) or states it is already in lowest terms
A step recognizes special outcomes like 0 or 3/3 = 1
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms before subtraction (tag S01/S02/S03 instead)
Only converting an improper fraction to a mixed number as a final presentation choice (not required by most items; if present, treat as part of simplification only when it accompanies reduction)

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and atypical mixed forms) into equivalent improper fractions by combining the whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number like a b/c into (a·c+b)/c
A step interprets/rewrites a form like 2 3/2 as 2 + 3/2 before converting
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S02 instead)
Only simplifying a fraction (tag S04 instead)
Only performing the subtraction once forms are ready (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds/uses a common denominator or LCM
A step scales numerator and denominator to convert to the common denominator
A step rewrites an integer as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is done (tag S03 instead)
Only converting mixed to improper without choosing a common denominator (tag S01 instead)
Only reducing/simplifying after computation (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the subtraction once numbers are in compatible forms, subtracting numerators over a common denominator and handling whole-plus-fraction decompositions when used.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts two fractions with the same denominator (e.g., (a−b)/d)
A step subtracts after converting to a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts by separating whole and fractional parts (e.g., (3−3)+(4/5−2/5))
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or rewriting equivalent fractions (tag S02 instead)
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions (tag S01 instead)
Only simplifying/reducing or converting improper to mixed after subtraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer or mixed number) consistent with the computed value.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4) or states it is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes the mixed-number equivalent)
A step finalizes as an integer when the fraction equals a whole number (e.g., 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Any step whose main action is performing the subtraction (tag S03 instead)
Any step whose main action is finding a common denominator (tag S02 instead)
Any step whose main action is converting mixed to improper before operating (tag S01 instead)
